messages:
toni: Heads up: moving to a shorter creative refresh cadence for the retargeting pool this quarter. From 10 days -> 5 days. Objective: fight ad fatigue and keep CPA within target. Any concerns?

rashid: That should help. We'll need to tighten the creative approval pipeline so assets are ready. Also ensure we don't over-test small segments.

evelyn: Ops notes: set cookie-level frequency cap to 6 impressions / 24h for retargeting. For creative swap we'll use server-side lookups to rotate creative ids. Also implement a cool-down of 48h after a new creative is shown before showing another to the same user.

ads-bot: Frequency and swap rules committed to campaign 'retarget_q2_fastswap' at 1725123899. JSON rule:```json
{"campaign":"retarget_q2_fastswap","freq_cap":{"imps":6,"hours":24},"cooldown_hours":48}
```

toni: Great. For messaging, prioritize new case-study short-form then fallback to product-benefit. Keep scarcity as last resort.

rashid: Also let's bump retarget bid multipliers by +10% for users who viewed pricing + visited demo in same session.

evelyn: Will exclude users who converted in last 30d. Also FYI this will slightly increase spend so update daily budgets.

toni: Ok going to run 1-week pilot with a holdout 10% to measure CPA delta. Deploy Monday. Will post results in 1-week check-in thread.
